name: Data pipeline: orchestration, dbt and a warehouse
summary: Sources are loaded on a schedule, transformed with dbt into tested models inside a warehouse, and served to dashboards. Dagster orchestrates (Airflow is the swap); DuckDB for small data, BigQuery or Snowflake as it grows.

fitsWhen.says: the team writes Python and SQL

avoidWhen.says: results must be live to the second

data.why: Assets with lineage: each table knows what it was built from and when.

database.why: Start in-process on Parquet; move to a hosted warehouse when data or users outgrow one machine.

backend.why: SQL models with tests and documentation, versioned in git.

observability.why: Data quality checks fail the run before bad data reaches a dashboard.

frontend.why: Dashboards and questions for people who do not write SQL.

infra.why: The orchestrator and its code location as containers.

ci-cd.why: dbt build on a slim sample for every pull request.

testing.why: Python assets tested with small fixtures.

hosting.why: One machine runs the orchestrator; the warehouse may be hosted.

dataStores.purpose: Landed source files as Parquet, never edited

dataStores.name: warehouse
dataStores.purpose: Staging and mart tables built by dbt
